fact: In October 2026 the Universal Health Insurance Authority said a unified health platform for all providers is still under study, and that its Insurance Management System runs in the five governorates applying universal insurance, with gradual linking of systems to follow.
title: التأمين الصحي الشامل: العمل على إنشاء منصة صحية موحدة تضم جميع مقدمي الخدمات في مصر
